# Daesin fixtures

Captured and independently inspected on 2026-09-07 using the maintainer-provided
form POST protocol. The real waybill and raw responses are not committed.

- `delivered.html`: reduced structural fixture from a successful live response.
  Three tracking rows and six timestamped events were observed, with delivery
  explicitly confirmed on the destination row.
- `not-found.html`: reduced structural fixture from one synthetic-number query
  that explicitly returned the carrier's no-history message.

Generated by `scripts/redact-daesin.mjs` after UTF-8 decoding. The script rebuilds
an allowlisted document, replaces all party/branch/contact data, and substitutes
timestamps while preserving their ordering. Scripts, URLs, attributes and other
response text are not copied. Changes require human review.
Tests derive incomplete/changed variants in memory; those are synthetic scenarios,
not additional live captures. EUC-KR test bytes are encoded from these sanitized
fixtures, not copies of production response bytes.
